QuestInfo.name: Not Quite Adventure Time
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Captain Vasily in Southperry.
QuestInfo.1: Captain Vasily says the Sangri-La's not quite ready for boarding yet.
QuestInfo.2: Captain Vasily says the Sangri-La's not quite ready for boarding yet. Then, you run into a really flustered girl.

0.0: It's free for beginner Explorers to use the Sangri-La, but we're still doing some maintenance on the ship. Mind waiting in town for a bit?

yes.0: Great. Mai must've taught you well. That girl is seriously amazing. Why don't you take a leisurely stroll around while we finish up here?

no.0: Well, the ship isn't ready yet. You're out of luck, mate. Go wait in town.
